# FUM Website

> FUM Website is a personal static site by FUM (fum0000) that collects interactive browser tools, Japanese-learning vocabulary pages, notes on Japan and everyday topics, mini games, cooking videos, plant-growing guides, music pages, and a blog/gallery.

- Canonical home: https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/index.html
- Author: F U M
- Hosting: GitHub Pages (static HTML, CSS and JavaScript; no build step required)
- Languages: mostly English UI and explanations, with Japanese content in the "My Note" section and some tool pages
- Sitemap: https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/robots.txt (all crawlers allowed)

Most pages are self-contained interactive apps. Content is updated regularly; the sitemap lists last-modified dates for each page.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/index.html): Entry point with an animated loading screen, site-wide navigation and a news ticker.
- [Guide](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Guide.html): A guided tour that walks through each themed section of the site with short explanations.
- [Setting](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Setting.html): Site preferences such as BGM, sound effects and volume.
- [Profile](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/AboutMe_Profile.html): Self-introduction of the author FUM, including greetings and hobbies.
- [Blog](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/AboutMe_Blog.html): Articles about the world and Japan, filterable by topic and date.
- [Gallery](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/AboutMe_Gallery.html): An interactive 3D virtual gallery for viewing the author's artworks.

## Japanese Learning

### Basics and grammar

- [Character](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_Basic_Character.html): Hiragana and katakana charts with special marks and pronunciation guides.
- [Grammar](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_Basic_Grammar.html): Japanese grammar basics, particles and sentence structure compared with English.
- [Verb Type](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_Verb_Type.html): The two verb groups (godan and ichidan) explained with examples.
- [Word - Verb](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_Basic_Verb.html): Essential Japanese verbs practiced with word cards.
- [Word - Adjective - i](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_Basic_Adjective_i.html): i-adjectives such as big, small and bright.
- [Word - Adjective - na](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_Basic_Adjective_na.html): na-adjectives such as pretty and important.
- [Word - Adverb](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_Basic_Adverb.html): Adverbs such as always, slowly and very.
- [Word - Asking](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_Basic_Asking.html): Question words and how to form questions in Japanese.
- [Word - General Word](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_Basic_GeneralWord.html): Everyday Japanese vocabulary taught with word cards.
- [Word - Conversation](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_Basic_Conversation.html): Conversation vocabulary for daily Japanese talk.
- [My Word Book](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_WordBook.html): Collect tricky words, review them with flashcards, earn study points for reviews and streaks, and track achievements and trophies.
- [Memory Mechanism](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_Basic_Memory.html): How memory works and five strategies for making vocabulary stick.
- [Learning Points](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_Basic_LearningPoints.html): Five essential mindset tips for studying Japanese effectively.

### Japalish (Japanized English)

- [Explanation](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_Japalish_Explanation.html): What JAPALISH is and how English-derived katakana words are used in Japan.
- [Level 1](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_Japalish_Level_1.html): Beginner words such as anime and smart phone.
- [Level 2](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_Japalish_Level_2.html): Intermediate words such as communication and stress.
- [Level 3](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_Japalish_Level_3.html): Advanced words such as install, global and concept.

### Reading and practice

- [Quiz](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_Quiz.html): Multiple-choice vocabulary quizzes with difficulty levels and favorites.
- [Japanese Folk Tales](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_FolkTales.html): Folk tales for reading aloud, with hiragana, parts of speech and English meanings.
- [Recommend Site](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japanese_Recommend_Learning.html): Hand-picked external sites recommended for learning Japanese.

## Japanese Culture

- [Japanese Art](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japan_Art.html): History of Japanese art and 50+ traditional patterns (monyo) drawn with HTML5 Canvas.
- [History of Food & Drink in Japan](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japan_History_Food.html): From Jomon hunter-gatherers to modern washoku and global fusion cuisine.
- [Food](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japan_Food.html): Everyday Japanese foods and side dishes sold at supermarkets.
- [Asian Cuisine](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japan_AsianCuisine.html): Chinese, Korean and other Asian restaurants in Japan.
- [Drink](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japan_Drink.html): Sake rice varieties, polishing ratios and the brewing process.
- [Snack](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japan_Snack.html): Japanese snacks such as chips, chocolate and gummies.
- [Tsuyu](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japan_Season_Tsuyu.html): The rainy season: climate, humidity and rain countermeasures.
- [Firework](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japan_Festival_Firework.html): The meaning of HANABI and Japan's summer firework festivals.
- [Travel](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japan_Travel.html): Money-saving transport options in Japan such as the Tokyo Free Kippu.
- [Shop - Overview](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japan_Shop_List.html): Shops commonly seen across Japan, linked to their official sites.
- [Shop - DAISO](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japan_Shop_Daiso.html): What you can buy at the nationwide 110-yen general store.
- [Statistics](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Japan_Statistics.html): Population, crime, wages, consumer prices and rice prices.

## Services (browser tools)

### Creator tools

- [Audio Editor](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Creator_AudioEditor.html): Waveform display and trimming in the browser.
- [Bezier Curve](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Creator_BezierCurve.html): Draw and tweak bezier curves and output code for them.
- [Binary Viewer](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Creator_BinaryViewer.html): Inspect a dropped file as raw hexadecimal/binary data.
- [Code Preview](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Creator_CodePreview.html): Write HTML, CSS and JavaScript and preview the result live.
- [Color Design](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Creator_ColorDesign.html): Explore colors and gradients with sliders.
- [Font Preview](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Creator_FontPreview.html): Preview and compare Japanese, English and Chinese Google Fonts.
- [Image Editor](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Creator_ImageEditor.html): Display, pan, zoom and crop images.
- [Image Layout](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Creator_ImageLayout.html): Compose photo layouts in a 3x3 grid by drag and drop.
- [QR Code](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Creator_QRCode.html): Generate customizable QR codes and scan QR codes from images.
- [Video Editor](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Creator_VideoEditor.html): Change resolution, frame rate and quality, then save a new MP4.

### Learning tools

- [Cat Health & Supplements](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Learning_Cat.html): Safe foods, foods to avoid and supplements for cats of different ages.
- [Constellation](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Learning_Constellation.html): Interactive 3D star map for learning constellations.
- [Exercise](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Learning_Exercise.html): Single movements explained by muscle group plus goal-based set menus.
- [Health](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Learning_Health.html): Breathing exercises, food-craving checks, supplement guide and simple Kampo formulas.
- [Music Theory](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Learning_MusicTheory.html): Practical chord progressions and modulation with simple score examples.
- [Time Travel](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Learning_TimeTravel.html): Pick a date to see an analog clock and events in Japan and the world.
- [Various Converters](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Learning_VariousConverters.html): Unit converters selectable by category.
- [Various Statistics](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Learning_VariousStatistics.html): Searchable statistical data with figures, explanations and tips.

### Enjoy and utility tools

- [Journey](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Enjoy_Journey.html): Travel the world through street view, with random journeys.
- [Counter Pick](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Enjoy_RecommendCounterPick.html): Set up matchups and get recommended counter-pick characters.
- [Roulette](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Enjoy_Roulette.html): Spin a roulette wheel to choose randomly between items.
- [Shogi Timer](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Enjoy_ShogiTimer.html): A shogi match timer with presets from 1 to 60 minutes.
- [Calculate Salary](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Others_CalculateSalary.html): Estimate pay from work hours, weekdays and time-of-day bonuses.
- [Optimization](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Service_Others_Optimization.html): A general decision/optimization calculator for break-even, pricing, expected value, budget allocation and crafting (Japanese UI).

## Games

- [Ping Pong](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Game_Ball.html): 3D skill game - sink a ping pong ball into a paper cup with realistic physics.
- [Block Rush](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Game_BlockRush.html): A 3-minute block puzzle; fill a full row to clear it before time runs out.
- [Tetris](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Game_Tetris.html): The classic falling-block puzzle with increasing speed.
- [Checkman](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Game_Checkbox.html): Time-attack game where you check off appearing checkboxes as fast as possible.
- [Fruit Merge Dungeon](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Game_FruitMergeDungeon.html): Fruit-dropping watermelon game mixed with RPG elements such as HP, levels and shops.
- [Geography Game](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Game_Geography.html): Geography training game with a quiz mode for chosen countries.
- [Hand Rock Paper Scissors](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Game_HandRPS.html): Play rock-paper-scissors against the computer using camera hand detection.
- [Hand Shooting](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Game_HandShooter.html): Point with your finger in front of the camera to shoot fruit targets.
- [Kanji Game](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Game_Kanji.html): Learn kanji through quizzes with scores, combos and unlockable rewards.
- [Kitty Hopper](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Game_KittyHopper.html): Endless jumping game where a cat hops over red barriers in 3D.
- [Market](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Game_Market.html): Trading simulation - buy low, repair and sell high to grow your net worth.
- [Random Question](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Game_RandomQuestion.html): Quiz tool that generates random questions from selected categories.
- [Reflex Speed](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Game_ReflexSpeed.html): Measure reaction time to a change on screen in milliseconds.
- [Warp Shot](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Game_Shooting.html): Arcade shooter where you manage HP, ammo and enemies.
- [Space Ship](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Game_SpaceShip.html): 3D space survival game - gather resources and upgrade your ship.
- [Type Infinity](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Game_TypeInfinity.html): Endless typing game with generated English sentences; one mistake ends the run.

- [3D Sakura Tree](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Test_Sakura.html): Realistic 3D cherry tree with pathfinding growth.
- [Introduction to Programming](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/Test_Programming_Introduction.html): What a program is, computer components and program structure.

## Site metadata

- [Sitemap](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/sitemap.xml): All indexed pages with last-modified dates.
- [robots.txt](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/robots.txt): Crawling rules; all user agents are allowed.
- [404 Not Found](https://fum0000.github.io/FUM_WebSite/404.html): Error page that returns visitors to the home page.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Pages are interactive; much of the visible content is rendered by JavaScript, so fetch and execute the page rather than relying only on the raw HTML.
- The site has no API. All tools run entirely in the browser, and user files (images, audio, video) are processed locally and are not uploaded.
- Content is available for indexing and summarization; please link back to the canonical page when quoting.
